children: The London Metal Exchange will launch a steel contract using prices from the Shanghai Futures Exchange on October 27, the LME said on Wednesday.
The exchange, the world's oldest and largest market for industrial metals, announced in June a groundbreaking deal with its Shanghai counterpart for the new contract.
